summary: This topic explains how to set up and configure various PDF templates like ID cards, certificates, and receipts within the ERP system, including naming, layout options, and class-specific templates.
steps: Navigate to Institute Setup > Template Reference > Template Preferences.
Click to add a new template or select an existing one.
Choose the template type (e.g., Fee Receipt, ID Card, Bonafide Certificate).
Select print count/layout options (Single, Two Horizontal, Two Vertical, Four).
Optionally, select specific courses/classes if the template is class-specific.
Select a default template from available backend options or load an existing one.
Use the preview option to check the design.
business_rules: Certificates can be different for respective classes (e.g., Class 1 vs. Class 2).
important_notes: The system allows adding multiple templates for the same type (e.g., multiple fee receipts).
Default templates are available at the backend.
Preview helps check alignment and design but is not the final print.
